svg.text: Deterministic below, judgement above. Every box is a file this repository actually contains.
you edit input/ — the system writes output/
broker export, dropped in as it comes
screened by the radar every day,
ticker → sector, a superset of every
name + one bellwether ETF per sector
2 · DETERMINISTIC — same inputs, same answer, every time
runs them in order, halts on the first non-zero exit, and stamps output/.state/run_manifest.json — step exits, artefact sha1s, and the radar verdict every downstream reader quotes verbatim
3 · JUDGEMENT — three subagents, three rule-sets, no agent reads another's
resolves every FAIL / PARTIAL row live
size = risk ÷ stop distance, then the cap
ten of its checks run as a script first
one canonical body per agent in agents/*.md → .claude/agents/ + .opencode/agent/ generated by tools/sync_agents.py · --check is the CI drift gate (invariant 8)
4 · OUTPUT AND AUDIT — never edited by hand
a generated file is an input, never a source of truth
one explicit signal per roster name,
every actionable call with a level
the blocks logged as well as the fills
regenerated every run and safe to
delete; every file carries its date
rebuilt from the feed on disagreement
fills → holdings CSV · promotions → watchlist · every decision → ledger
5 · READ ON DEMAND — never loaded up front, which is what keeps a daily run cheap
one plugin folder per data leg
Editable source: docs/Technical_Architecture.svg · if the picture and docs/TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md disagree, the picture is stale.
